html:
G'oya

Har mijoz uchun orders da birorta qator bor-yo'qligini tekshiramiz, yo'q bo'lsa o'chiramiz. Bor-yo'qlik savoliga NOT EXISTS mos.

Yechim

DELETE FROM customers
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM orders o
  WHERE o.customer_id = customers.id
)

Subquery har mijoz uchun alohida bajariladi, customers.id o'chirilayotgan qatorning id'si. Mehmon buyurtmalari (customer_id NULL) hech bir mijozga teng emas va natijaga ta'sir qilmaydi.

Tuzoqlar

Eng mashhur tuzoq NOT IN. orders da bitta NULL bo'lsa, id NOT IN (1, 3, NULL) hech kim uchun rost bo'lmaydi: Malika 1 ga ham, 3 ga ham teng emas, lekin NULL ga tengmi yoki yo'qmi, noma'lum. Natijada hech kim o'chirilmaydi va xato ham chiqmaydi.

Noto'g'riDELETE FROM customers
WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

NOT IN ni saqlab qolmoqchi bo'lsangiz, subquery'dan NULL larni olib tashlang: WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL. Lekin buni har safar eslab yurish kerak, NOT EXISTS da esa bunday muammo yo'q.
